messages.subject: YAML fix integrated and pushed
messages.body: Fixed the orca-development skill frontmatter with a folded YAML scalar, added explicit guidance to read the version-matched orchestration guide when coordinating Tasks/Dispatches/messages, and updated the report so it no longer implies afdd9da was parser-validated. I verified package shape, paths, local links, Bun.YAML.parse frontmatter parsing, and git diff hygiene, then fast-forwarded /home/alex/Work/pi-orca main from clean 8d98328 to ab768bb89b1bce920f40e0feebdac2fe7b957db4 and pushed origin/main to the same hash. Remaining work is parent-owned native acceptance and any later rollout; push succeeded despite a stale gh credential-helper warning that was bypassed with a command-local current gh helper and no global settings changes.
